title: Gesture Control Use and Availability
summary: Feedback about gesture control centers on convenience for radio or media use, alongside complaints about frustration, inconsistent operation, accidental activation, and removal of the feature.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise gesture control as convenient and enjoyable for managing music or radio functions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on gesture control being frustrating, unreliable, or removed when customers expected it to be included.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention both appreciation and complaints about gesture control, including coolness, convenience, inconsistency, accidental activation, and requests for more selective disabling.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment reading.
The topic includes related but not fully consistent subjects such as using gesture control, accidental activation, feature removal, and control-zone behavior.
One positive example appears to reference vent speed control rather than gesture control specifically, so the positive theme has limited direct evidence.
